solution_files.leap.s:
// Returns 1 if the year in x0 is a leap year, and 0 otherwise.
.text
.globl leap_year

leap_year:
    mov    x9, #4
    udiv   x1, x0, x9
    msub   x1, x1, x9, x0
    cbnz   x1, no_leap          // not divisible by 4

    mov    x9, #400
    udiv   x1, x0, x9
    msub   x1, x1, x9, x0
    cbz    x1, leap

    mov    x9, #100
    udiv   x1, x0, x9
    msub   x1, x1, x9, x0
    cbz    x1, no_leap

leap:
    mov    x0, #1
    ret

no_leap:
    mov    x0, #0
    ret
